verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents a pay-per-deposit check service: checks received in the mailbox are deposited without the customer going to the bank, and requests are processed and mailed out to the customer's bank within 1 business day. Express shipping is offered, and multiple checks can be batched. However, the deposit happens by mailing the paper check to the bank rather than direct electronic deposit, and nothing covers endorsement or reconciliation. Missing for 10: documented check endorsement handling, reconciliation/deposit-confirmation tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.
